row.answer: Ziggs is an AP-focused mage who fights with bouncing bombs, slowing minefields and a long-range blast. His damage is magic, and his satchel can knock enemies away, reposition him and execute weakened turrets.
row.counterplay: Dodge bombs, route around mines and look for an opening after he uses his satchel.
